text:
Before I met Dr. Bee, my cat, Giant, had peeling paws and sores on his mouth. I took him to many vets, and they all said it was a fungal infection or an allergy to floor cleaner. But he didn't get better, and his condition worsened. He couldn't eat, vomited, and when his mouth hurt, he would drink very little water. He also had digestive problems. Then I met Dr. Bee, who is incredibly kind. She diagnosed Giant with a protein allergy and has been treating and caring for him ever since. Whenever we leave Giant with her, we feel so secure, like we're raising him ourselves (he's even happier with a vet than with us, haha). Dr. Bee seems to genuinely love Giant. Normally, Giant is very timid and dislikes vets, but since being with Dr. Bee, he's not afraid at all.

Regarding baths, Giant's fur always gets wet no matter where we bathed him. Then we met Dr. Bee, who recommended a special shampoo. She's the only vet who can dry Giant's fur so quickly that we don't need to come back to blow-dry him anymore. For us, it's well worth the price.💓💓 Sometimes they even have promotions and discounts, and they also do photo shoots for various festivals.

As for boarding at a pet hotel, Dr. Bee and her assistant take such good care of Giant that he's become quite fond of it. Every time we leave him at the hotel, Giant never wants to go home!
